value.rationale: PASS: Cruciani--Dudeja identify the loss scale p=c/n as the transition between recoverable collection and rapid forgetting, and introduce a spatial-independence heuristic. Determining the exact stationary all-present probability and showing its first-order exponential rate differs strictly from the product of exact stationary marginals addresses a structural dependence gap at that natural threshold; it is not an arbitrary finite parameter slice, isolated table, or textbook substitution. The exact joint law also quantifies negative correlations and stationary synchronization flux, without claiming a hitting-time distribution.
